programme.title: Max Havoc: Curse of the Dragon
programme.desc: Exotic action/adventure and martial arts blend together as Max Havoc, world famous kickboxer turned sports photographer, faces the relentless Black Dragons in a reluctant quest to save the lovely Goody sisters and to avenge the death of good friend Tahsi in Guam.

programme.title: Max Havoc: Ring of Fire
programme.desc: Max Havoc is on a new assignment staying at a luxury hotel in the heart of a big city only to discover that the classy hotel owner is a vicious mob boss heading up a crime ring full of unwanted teenagers in the nearby slums.

programme.title: San Saba
programme.desc: Private Investigator Bud wakes from a coma in a hospital room and is immediately charged with murder but did he do it or was he framed? As the story unfolds in flashback, Bud discovers that no one seems to be who he or she claim to be and everyone's motives are suspect.

programme.title: Universal Soldier II: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Luc and Veronica recover and revive Luc's long-lost brother who has been suspended in a cryo-chamber for decades and attempt to expose the Unisol program, led by Mazur (Gary Busey), which recycles dead soldiers in the attempt to create the ultimate mercenary army.

programme.title: Universal Soldier III: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: Veronica and Luc conclude their quest to expose the Unisol program to the media and destroy Mentor's (Burt Reynolds) billion dollar heist, while the evil Dr. Walker creates a genetically engineered Unisol GR87, programmed with the single mission to destroy Luc and Veronica.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: GP Racing
programme.desc: All the news, drama and glamour from the high-paced world of Formula 1, all in a dynamic 30 minute magazine format.

programme.title: Horror High 2020 Tyler J. Case
programme.desc: A monster lurks around a high school in the hypnotized town of Willow Hills and picks off tardy students one by one. Now it is up to an unlikely group of teens to put an end to the terror that has plagued many...

programme.title: Lake Terror
programme.desc: Remington has escaped the evil cabin but now the evil continues to follow him, wreaking havoc wherever he goes. Meanwhile, Chloe and Revel look for a missing sister that went to the evil cabin in the previous installment. The two meet Vincent, a failing TV host, to help psychically contact the missing sister. That's when a gunshot rings out in the night and the three meet Remington. Now they all must battle for their lives against the evil that pursues Remington to once and for all lock the evil away for good...

programme.title: Jack and Jill: The Hills of Hell
programme.desc: After searching for her missing daughter, a lady and her search party discover the legend behind the murderous pair of Jack and Jill...

programme.title: Village of the Vampire
programme.desc: Rebecca is searching for her sister, a young journalist who went missing while investigating a series of unfortunate events. The trail leads her to Timere, a remote place far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, where amidst the tight lipped silence of the town's inhabitants there's an ever growing fear of dark forces at work and no-one dares to leave their home at night. Here Rebecca meets an extravagant writer, the church warden of the town and above all Caleb, a charming, rich and elegant man whose dark gaze hides a chilling secret. It's in this town, where time appears to move between the shadows and danger lurks around every corner that Rebecca learns of the terrible truth and the battle between good and evil begins...

programme.title: Clown Motel
programme.desc: Clown Motel follows a group of ghost hunters, coming from an old ghost town and a bachelorette party, returning home from Las Vegas. When the groups meet up, by mistake, they're left to discover if the motel is really abandoned and haunted by the souls, of the clowns, that once lived there...

programme.title: Demon Baby
programme.desc: A young couple looking to rekindle a damaged relationship retreat to the remote Scottish Highlands. They are haunted by their past, their surroundings and each other.

programme.title: The Last Nosferatu
programme.desc: Ethan has been single for several months and decides to meet people via the Internet. One night, he dates “Black Pearl” whom he literally falls in love with, but she disappears, so he decides to go looking for her. One evening, Black Pearl resurfaces and seems to be hiding a mysterious secret that will lead him to a tragic fate...

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: After his daughter goes missing, a wealthy contractor hires a group of investigative journalists to probe into an abandoned town with hope of uncovering clues about her disappearance...

programme.title: Early Grave
programme.desc: On the eve of their ten year high school reunion, six people are summoned to the isolated country estate of one of their former friends, now a famous horror writer. Once there, separated by guilt, yet bound together by a terrible secret, seven adults try to reconnect with each other, and take stock of their lives. Outside, the storm clouds gather. Rain, lightning and wind isolate the house by washing out the road and knocking down the power lines. And then, they begin to be brutally murdered one by one. Someone is out there in the wind and the rain, someone who has waited for ten years to wreak a terrible vengeance on this group. Seven friends find themselves in a struggle to survive and outwit a diabolical killer who is savagely committed to sending them all to an EARLY GRAVE...

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a mysterious crash and uncovers more than an object, but a massive government conspiracy. Inspired by the real life events of December 9, 1965 and one of America's most mysterious UFO incidents...

programme.title: Witch Trials
programme.desc: Two documentary filmmakers and an ex-cop investigate the disappearance of a young girl that is rumored to have been abducted by a witch in the haunted woods of Connecticut...

programme.title: Ouija Room
programme.desc: An agoraphobic woman with autism begins summoning spirits to be her friends while her brother/caretaker is gone during the day, but the more time she spends with the spirits the more it becomes clear they aren't so friendly after all...

programme.title: Haunted
programme.desc: An aspiring writer pays a visit to his sister to look after her house while she is out of town, but what he finds there is more terrifying than any of the stories he writes...

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: Van Helsing is called upon to help save a missing girl and her friends from a hoard of demons...

programme.title: Cemetery Stories
programme.desc: On Halloween a couple, both of which are clairvoyants, drive to a cemetery. They go for fun to pick up vibrations from the tombstones of the deceased. As they pick up vibrations they have visions of how the person died. Each vibration and vision seems to get darker and darker. In the midst of all of this, they are being stalked by a dark shadowy figure. What starts out as some Halloween fun quickly turns to terror...

programme.title: Groupie
programme.desc: When a mysterious groupie joins legendary cursed band, "The Dark Knights", a series of unexplained murders derails their comeback tour...

programme.title: Rise of the Mummy
programme.desc: A group of archaeology students awaken an ancient mummy. After being trapped in a time loop, the only way they can escape, is to defeat the mummy. As the body count rises, it seems the Mummy has to collect the souls of those who woke him to be able to walk the earth - for good...

programme.title: My Bloody Birthday
programme.desc: After a terrible trauma on her birthday, Emma chooses not to celebrate it again. But when she turns 21, a friend of her breaks the ritual with a surprise party, unaware of awakening horrors, which for years have been waiting in the darkness...

programme.title: Slasher.com
programme.desc: After meeting online, Jack and Kristy go on a weekend getaway to the woodlands of rural Missouri. While discovering each other, they soon learn of the terrorizing horrors that the forest has in store...

programme.title: The Fear
programme.desc: The Bloody Hand tells the story of a student named Hien who studies in Little Saigon. Her peaceful life completely changes when the young girl rents a room that was once owned by Lien the daughter of the landlord, who was kidnapped, raped and killed by five criminals, who were never caught...

programme.title: The Devil's Fairground
programme.desc: Starring Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson and John Charles Dickson. The Stars of two competing and colliding paranormal television shows converge on an abandoned haunted amusement park which ends up being the epicenter to hell. They are now all trapped - in an all out war against pure evil...

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: A young Nurse is assigned to look after a patient in a remote location in the English countryside. As the night continues she finds herself terrorized by an unseen force that is connected with her patient...

programme.title: Ouija Hosts
programme.desc: Presenters of paranormal TV show "Ghost Hosts" are filming in an abandoned haunted building as part of a Halloween special. The stories surrounding the horrifying ghosts of the mansion are about to become reality...

programme.title: The Devil's Forest
programme.desc: Rachel and her team of film makers travel to Transylvania, Romania, to document the paranormal phenomena within Hoia-Baciu Forest...

programme.title: Ghost Boat
programme.desc: Trapped aboard the family yacht, Samantha lives out her personal Hell, night after night, answering to the cruel and painful demands of the ship's alarm system. Taking a journey into the depths of depravity, she wakes each morning to the disfiguring scars left by the previous night's horror and searches for the answer to a missing memory: 'Could I have killed my family... Or did Hell get it wrong?

programme.title: H.P. Lovecraft's Monster Portal
programme.desc: A cult is about to waken H.P. Lovecraft's most feared creature...

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Rose awakes in an unknown house following a serious car accident with memory loss and no ability to walk. Her Mother and boyfriend are there to help her. Rose wants to piece together her life before the accident. All is not what it seems...

programme.title: Poltergeist Americano
programme.desc: Horribles visiones atormentan a Taryn cuando ella, su hermano y sus compañeros de universidad se mudan a una vieja e infame casa. Entonces, sus sangrientas alucinaciones se vuelven demasiado reales...

programme.title: Isla de las Muñecas
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas va a la legendaria Isla de las Muñecas para conocer la verdad mortal...

programme.title: El Mal Interior
programme.desc: Un chico solitario y mentalmente discapacitado se hace amigo de su reflejo en un espejo antiguo. Esta criatura demoníaca le ordena que se lance a una matanza asesina de las personas que más quiere...

programme.title: Ana
programme.desc: Dos hombres roban una muñeca de un museo que, sin saberlo, abre una puerta al Infierno...

programme.title: Alfredo
programme.desc: Brendan Cobbs, un famoso novelista, es enviado a una remota cabaña de la Inglaterra rural en busca de inspiración para su próxima novela. Cree haber encontrado su próximo tema cuando se encuentra con Alfred, un muñeco del tamaño de un niño que puede cobrar vida. Pero surgen consecuencias mortales cuando Brendan se da cuenta de que Alfred tiene intención de matar.

programme.title: Hotel Dinosaurio
programme.desc: Sienna está desesperada por ganar un gran premio en metálico en un concurso secreto clandestino, pero los dinosaurios comienzan a cazarla para entretenimiento de los ricos y adinerados. ¿Podrá ser la última en sobrevivir a la horrible noche para ganar el premio?

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: Un reportero investiga un misterioso accidente y descubre algo más que un objeto, sino una enorme conspiración gubernamental. Inspirada en los hechos reales del 9 de diciembre de 1965 y en uno de los incidentes OVNI más misteriosos de Estados Unidos...

programme.title: El Culto de Humpty Dumpty
programme.desc: Un grupo de adolescentes con problemas y su maestra deben luchar por sobrevivir después de descubrir que una secta ha devuelto la vida a Humpty Dumpty, un muñeco asesino, y lo ha liberado en el campamento en el que se encuentran...

programme.title: El Bosque del Diablo
programme.desc: Rachel y su equipo de cineastas viajan a Transilvania, Rumania, para documentar los fenómenos paranormales en el bosque de Hoia-Baciu...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Jack y Jill: Las Colinas del Infierno
programme.desc: Tras buscar a su hija desaparecida, una dama y su grupo de búsqueda descubren la leyenda que se esconde tras la pareja asesina de Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Ouija: Reunión Mortal
programme.desc: Sucesos extraños les ocurren a unos amigos antes de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un gran almacén. Dos de ellos encuentran un viejo tablero de espiritismo y deciden contactar con los antiguos inquilinos de la víctima fallecida...

programme.title: El Resurgir de la Momia
programme.desc: Un grupo de estudiantes de arqueología despierta a una momia ancestral. Tras quedar atrapados en un bucle temporal, la única forma de escapar es derrotarla. A medida que aumenta el número de cadáveres, parece que la Momia debe recolectar las almas de quienes la despertaron para poder caminar sobre la tierra, para siempre...

programme.title: Jack y Jill 3
programme.desc: 10 años después de los últimos asesinatos atroces en la colina, Jack y Jill están de regreso para masacrar al elenco y al equipo de un programa de Internet en vivo que busca descubrir los secretos de la leyenda...

programme.title: El Demonio Interior
programme.desc: Años después de salir de la cárcel, Sam Parsons intenta rehacer su vida con su mujer Courtney y su hija Harper. Trabaja duro para mantener a su familia y permitirse una bonita casa en su tranquilo barrio de las afueras. Cuando empiezan a ocurrir sucesos sobrenaturales en la casa, Sam teme por la seguridad de su mujer y su hija. Cuando los sucesos se convierten en ataques, Sam contrata a Corbin Carlysle y a su equipo de cazafantasmas conocido como «The Ghost Killers», para que le ayuden a luchar contra la entidad oscura que acecha en las sombras de su casa. Cuando las cosas empiezan a complicarse y queda claro que esta entidad es mucho más peligrosa que el típico fantasma, surgen complicaciones cuando Corbin y su equipo se centran más en la fama y la fortuna. Para ganar esta lucha Sam debe luchar contra sus propios demonios interiores y volver a su violento pasado. Para salvar a sus seres queridos, un Demonio debe enfrentarse a un Demonio.

programme.title: Portal de Monstruos de H.P. Lovecraft
programme.desc: Una secta está a punto de despertar a la criatura más temida de H.P. Lovecraft...

programme.title: El Director (Las Siete Madres de Edipo)
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes estudiantes de actuación siguiendo sus sueños se embarcan en un proyecto para filmar una película de terror que no resulta ser lo que esperaban.

programme.title: La Mujer que Hablaba con Los Muertos
programme.desc: Es un film de Terror. Cuando Elena Castaño era una niña, tenía un don: era capaz de comunicarse con los espíritus de los muertos. pero esa capacidad desapareció al crecer.

programme.title: El Cóndor En Nueva York
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante de Nueva York, llamado Damián, ha creado una nueva droga con efectos impactantes.

programme.title: Catemaco: Magia y Misterio
programme.desc: Una familia normal va de vacaciones a Catemaco, Michoacan un pueblo famoso y pintoresco en Mexico. Todo marcha bien hasta que son atacados por criminales, el padre sobrevive, y con ayuda del brujo mayor del pueblo cobra venganza.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: El Sonido de los Tulipanes
programme.desc: En Buenos Aires durante la crisis del 2001, Marcelo un escritor devenido en periodista, debe volver sobre los últimos pasos de su padre Tonio un consagrado intelectual de quien se encuentra profundamente distanciado cuando muere en condiciones extrañas.

programme.title: 48 Horas de Terror
programme.desc: Mateo un escritor citadino adquiere una casa de campo en donde planea vivir con su esposa y escribir en la tranquilidad del campo, pero no tomo en cuenta las trágicas noticias de los acontecimientos de canibalismo que ocurrieron a manos de sus vecinos quienes solo buscan sacias su hambre.

programme.title: Terror En La Montaña
programme.desc: Un soldado regresa a su país tras participar en la Guerra de las Malvinas y descubre que su esposa lo engaña con un alto político.

programme.title: La Araña Vampiro
programme.desc: Jerónimo tiene 20 años y está medicado con psicofármacos. Su padre piensa que unos días en un entorno natural pueden curarlo y decide llevarlo a una casa perdida en la montaña.

programme.title: Beber de tu Sangre
programme.desc: Una vampira se enamora de un hombre que conoció en un bar. Un vampiro invita a una mujer embarazada y a sus amigos a ver su obra de teatro. Estos dos vampiros son marido y mujer. Pero Ala ni y Gabriel son una pareja de vampiros aburridos de su larga vida en pareja. Ella decide tener un hijo, pero él no lo desea. Los problemas empiezan cuando Ala ni conoce y se enamora de Javier, pero no sabe que está casado con Lizvet y mucho menos que va a tener un hijo con ella.

programme.title: Escape En Vivo
programme.desc: Un investigador paranormal descubre una tierra de nadie infernal en un remoto y olvidado paisaje desértico donde payasos malvados esperan en un purgatorio sobrenatural para enfrentar su destino como venganza por sus malas acciones.

programme.title: Terror En La Sangre

programme.title: Sanatorio
programme.desc: Rachel y Ryan son dos influencers populares que harán cualquier cosa para conseguir algunos Me gusta más y ganar el próximo desafío virtual.

programme.title: La Peste (Renaceremos de Nuestras Cenizas)
programme.desc: En un pueblito en donde reinaba la paz y tranquilidad un día inesperado sin saber cómo ni de donde cayó “La Peste” hundiendo a sus habitantes en la desolación y en la desesperanza, pero en medio de esa oscuridad surgirá un pequeño grupo de personas que ayudará a combatirla y a detenerla para siempre.

programme.desc: Katie, co-owner of Studio 882, an interior design and furniture showroom out of Glen Mills, PA. Katie believes she has found the secret sauce that will grow the business to the next level and enable her to expand around the US. Shes reapplying airport software, including air traffic control monitoring and facial recognition, to enhance the customer experience and mine valuable information about why one sofa sits and one sofa fits. It's a potential treasure trove of information if her team would put it to use.

programme.title: How Columbia Sportswear Stands Out in a Crowded Market
programme.desc: Columbia Sportswear CEO Tim Boyle discusses how the company repositioned its legacy brand by bringing more fun into the outdoor apparel industry.

programme.title: Con Quesos & Juice Palm
programme.desc: Omar Kasim opened a fusion taco restaurant, only to be pushed out by an investor. Starting again, Omar opened a cold-pressed juice bar, Juice Palm. Over time, the investor ran Con Quesos into the ground, and Omar was able to buy back his first restaurant.

programme.title: How To Find A Job You Love and The Importance Of Having A Vision In Life
programme.desc: Having a vision matters because it will help you find a job you love. The thing is, too many people end up working jobs that make them feel unfulfilled. By taking time to figure out what you really want, you can set yourself on the path to finding your dream job. There are two broad categories of jobs out there: survival jobs and dream jobs. Survival jobs are those jobs that you take for a variety of reasons, but they arent really what you aspire to. Maybe you needed money to pay off a loan, or maybe a job didnt turn out the way you thought it would but you didnt feel like changing. Dream jobs, on the other hand, are jobs that make you feel alive. So why arent more of us working our dream jobs? Well, it can be difficult to find a job you love if you dont even know what that dream job would look like. This is why having a vision is so critical. A vision provides clarity and direction for your life.

programme.title: DON'T Compare Yourself To Others and Why Comparison Is Killing Your Joy
programme.desc: In the age of social media, comparison is an all too common issue. Whether we realize it or not, we're constantly comparing ourselves to others; the problem is that it's killing our joy. That's right. Much of the time, all it's doing is making us less satisfied with ourselves. We only see the best parts of people around us and compare them to the worst parts of our lives. Learn why we must stop this cycle, and exactly how you can do it.

programme.title: The Art of Being a Self Made Millionaire with Hip Hop's Hottest Rapper Nipsey Hussle
programme.desc: Nipsey Hussle is arguably hip hop's hottest star right now, with his much anticipated album release of Victory Lap. Hussle has been making his name from a steady stream of mixtapes including 2013s Crenshaw, which he sold at $100 a pop, netting $100,000 in the process. He's collaborated with artists like YG, Diddy, and Jeezy. His record label All In Records recently partnered with Atlantic Records to increase his distribution and he's turning the industry on its head by owning the rights to his music. He's an entrepreneur in every sense with multiple businesses including his record label, his clothing brand called The Marathon Company and is even an early investor in some blockchain based startups.

programme.title: The Greatest Company Inception Story with theChive Brothers
programme.desc: Brothers John Resig and Leo Resig founded Chive Media Group and its flagship site, theCHIVE.com, in November 2008 with no capital and a lot of hustle. Leo was living in Chicago (CHI) and John was living in Venice (VE) and thats how theCHIVE was born. With backgrounds in digital publishing and the financial backing from partner, Doug Schaaf, John and Leo were able to turn a three-man project into the nationwide, 170-employee entertainment digital media company that Chive Media Group is today.

programme.title: How To Build Generational Wealth Starting with Your Children
programme.desc: Hey everyone! Today we're diving into an eye-opening conversation with Holly Reid, CEO of The Master Playbook. Holly's on a mission to help families and business owners build lasting wealth and leave a powerful legacy. In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, key takeaways from our chat included: 1. Legacy building isn't just for the ultra-rich. It's about creating value that lasts beyond your lifetime. 2. Forget complex financial jargon - Holly focuses on mindset shifts to kickstart your wealth journey. 3. Resistance from family members? Holly offers tips to address concerns and highlight the positive impact of increased wealth. 4. We discuss the importance of preparing your business for unexpected events. Holly shared a personal story that really drives this point home. 5. Action steps you can take today: Adopt a "legacy builder mentality," invest in yourself and your community, and start documenting your business assets properly. Holly's company, The Master Playbook, is all about empowering the next generation to master money. Whether you're a parent or a business owner, her insights can help you create a lasting financial impact. Remember, as Holly says, "Legacy isn't built on intention alone. You have to take intentional action." So let's get out there and start building our financial legacies!

programme.title: Embracing Courageous Leadership
programme.desc: Starting and running a business can be frightening even for the bravest among us. It takes a special kind of grit to face the uncertainties and challenges you encounter on the road to startup. Recently, Ramon Ray chatted with Lisa Blackmon, Esquire — aka Lisa B, the Life Changer — about how crucial courage is for business leaders. Lisa, who helps individuals become more courageous leaders, has a background in law and over 25 years of experience in running her own business. In this article, we'll dig into Lisa's insights, giving straightforward tips for entrepreneurs to be brave leaders and enhance their skills.

programme.title: Unlocking LinkedIn Audio: A Conversation with Shameka Brathwaite
programme.desc: Whether you’re a startup entrepreneur pursuing your passions or a seasoned corporate professional seeking networking opportunities, LinkedIn is a go-to resource you won’t want to overlook. The platform is constantly evolving to provide innovative avenues for connection and collaboration. One such groundbreaking feature is LinkedIn Audio Events — a platform that allows creators to host live, interactive conversations with a global audience. To explore LinkedIn Audio’s capabilities, Ramon Ray sat down with Shameka Brathwaite, a leadership productivity expert and prominent user of this platform. Below, we explore best practices and tips on making the most of LinkedIn Audio and avoiding common pitfalls.

programme.title: Use CRM Right from the Start Says Salesforce Exec
programme.desc: Whether you’re in the beginning stages of starting a business or you’ve been at it for a while, you know how important it is to facilitate smooth and effective communications with customers. Customer relationship management (CRM) tools make keeping in touch and developing a loyal customer base easier. However, knowing which CRM tools are best for startups can be challenging for new business owners who may not yet need an enterprise-level solution. Choosing a tool that can scale with you is the best way to make the most of a CRM solution, and that’s what Salesforce Starter aims to do. Recently launched by Salesforce to support small businesses, Salesforce Starter is an all-in-one CRM app combining sales, service, and marketing capabilities. Recently, Ramon Ray had the opportunity to explore the world of Salesforce Starter with Kris Billmair, the Senior Vice President and General Manager of the self-service and growth team at Salesforce. This article offers key takeaways on how a CRM tool like Salesforce Starter can help small businesses better manage customer relationships, centralize data, and grow more efficiently.

programme.title: New App Helps You Make Money by Talking Owwll App
programme.desc: In a world where communication often takes the form of text messages and social media chats, Jason Hill, the creator of the Owwll app, had a vision to bring back the power of one-on-one audio conversations. In a recent interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, Hill discussed the birth of Owwll, its unique features, and how it's transforming networking and collaboration in the digital age. Owwll is more than just an app; it's a game-changer for personal and professional connections.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Lords of Chaos
programme.desc: Based on true events, the film chronicles the rise of Norwegian black metal music scene in the early 1990s. Young musicians form bands that descend into church burnings, violence, and murder, with tragic consequences for the underground music community.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: Margot, a happily married woman, develops an intense attraction to her charming neighbor Daniel. She struggles between comfortable marriage and passionate desire, exploring themes of commitment, longing, and whether giving in to temptation will bring happiness or destroy everything.

programme.title: Mr. 3000
programme.desc: Aging baseball legend Stan Ross discovers that three of his 3,000 career hits were incorrectly counted. Nine years after retiring, the arrogant player returns to baseball at age 47 to reclaim his record and legacy while learning humility and what truly matters.

programme.title: Baby Boy
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Jody lives with his mother while fathering children with two different women. When his mother's new boyfriend moves in, Jody is forced to confront his immaturity and finally grow up, facing the commitments and responsibilities of real life as an African-American man.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Oscar Grant's last day, January 1, 2009. The 22-year-old Bay Area resident celebrates New Year's Eve with family and friends before a confrontation with police at Fruitvale BART station leads to his tragic death, sparking national outrage.

programme.title: 500 Days of Summer
programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Tom Hansen works at a greeting card company and falls for Summer, a woman who doesn't believe in true love. The nonlinear narrative follows 500 days of their relationship as Tom reflects on where things went wrong after she unexpectedly dumps him.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: To escape neighborhood bully Deebo, Craig moves to the suburbs to live with his uncle and cousin Day-Day. What should be a peaceful change becomes complicated when they encounter new troubles including thieves, romantic interests, and neighborhood conflicts in Rancho Cucamonga.

programme.title: Death at a Funeral
programme.desc: A funeral ceremony descends into chaos when a mysterious stranger arrives with a shocking secret about the deceased. Family tensions, mistaken drug consumption, and unexpected revelations turn the somber occasion into an outrageous comedy of errors filled with embarrassing disasters.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Based on a true story, Ron Stallworth becomes the first African-American detective in Colorado Springs Police Department. In the 1970s, he successfully infiltrates the local Ku Klux Klan chapter with the help of a Jewish colleague, exposing their violent plans while maintaining his cover.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: Playboy bunny Shelley is kicked out of the mansion and becomes house mother for a struggling sorority of socially awkward girls. She teaches them about confidence and style while they help her discover there's more to life than appearance, transforming each other in the process.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Best friends Sidney and Dre share a lifelong love of hip-hop music. As they navigate their careers in the music industry—she as a magazine editor, he as a record executive—they must confront whether their deep connection is just friendship or something more romantic.

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day work as security guards at a local shopping mall on Christmas Eve. When a crooked Santa Claus robs their apartment, they must navigate holiday chaos, pursue the thief, and try to recover their stolen presents and rent money before it's too late.

programme.title: The M&MJ LateSHOW Season 3 Episode 1 "The Second One With JeRonelle"
programme.desc: JeRonelle Joins Tampico Joness on this hilarious episode of the M&MJ LateShow. Laughs, challenging games, giving a powerhouse performance and sharing exclusive updates you won’t want to miss!

programme.title: To Cut
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring story of Stuart Linder, a prominent American plasticsurgeon. Once deterred by his teachers from pursuing medical practices, now one of the most sough after professionals in practice.

programme.title: Viral
programme.desc: Unable to come to terms with the death of his brother by the hands of a police officer, Quincy is pushed to face his emotions and navigate his new reality. In doing so, he is presented with an opportunity to seek justice in an unconventional way.

programme.title: Xavier
programme.desc: A biographical documentary short that tells the story of a chance meeting of social media peronality Blake Linder and cancer warrior Xavier Mejias. This visual challenges audiences to reach for higher levels of compassion, selflessness, mentorship and gratefulness while begging the question "are you truly connecting with people on social media".

programme.title: All My Friends Are Robots
programme.desc: After one brother clicks a strange hyperlink, two siblings must battle their best friend—now transformed into a relentless humanoid—before the glitch consumes them all.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: When Xavier unexpectedly receives the ashes of his dead father in the mail, he is forced to confront a lifetime of daddy issues.

programme.title: Below Watson's
programme.desc: Beneath the charm of Watson’s Soda Fountain and Café on East Chapman Avenue in Orange, California, lies a mystery sealed in brick and shadow. Once a bustling drug store and diner during the Prohibition era, the café is said to sit above a hidden network of tunnels that have long been blocked from public view. Were these tunnels a lifeline, a smuggling route—or something far more dangerous? This documentary highlights the community that whispers about the layers of history, chasing the echoes of footsteps that may never have wanted to be found.

programme.title: Candles
programme.desc: In this short psychological thriller, a seemingly grieveing and sinister teen boy. Is his therapist an emotional anchor? Or is she someone quite sinister herself?

programme.title: Chick Bait
programme.desc: In this lighthearted comedy, a lonely, overweight man just wants to enjoy a quiet afternoon and his baskin robbins Ice cream. But his simple pleasure takes a wild turn when a mischievous dachshund waddles up, steals his sweet trea. the man tries to shoo the dog away, but fate has other plans. A charming young woman notices the adorable thief and mistakes the man for its doting owner. Suddenly thrust into an unexpected role, he finds himself sharing laughs and lunch with her, daydreaming that maybe, just maybe, this accident could lead to love. But just as the sparks begin to flicker, disaster strikes. The real owner appears, frantic and furious at finding the “lost” dog in the man’s company. A story of ice cream, mistaken identity, and a very determined little dog.

programme.title: Dream To Sell
programme.desc: A biographical documentary that tells the inspiring rags to riches story of Simon Sarradine, a prominent American with lebanese ancestry. Once a struggling boy, now the king of a motor-vehicle empire, who continues to dream bigger.

programme.title: Father Figure
programme.desc: Richard kidnaps his two children, consumed by resentment toward his ex-wife, Diana, and convinced that only he can provide them a safe home. But as his desperation grows, Richard's obsessive need for control begins to expose the monstrous reflection of his own flaws. Meanwhile, their fractured family becomes the target of the Father Figure-a sinister entity that preys on children from broken, unstable homes. When the demon abducts the children, Richard is forced to face the consequences of his destructive choices and the darker truths about himself. Now, he must confront the ultimate evil to save his children, before his mistakes doom him forever.

programme.title: Influence
programme.desc: A young man's battle with the influence of alcohol

programme.title: Jelly
programme.desc: A unsuspecting couple stumble into a doughnut shop looking for relief and refreshments but end up getting more than the standard customer service.

programme.title: Mic’d Up Season 1 Episode 012: Ronnie 2k

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 002: Valentine’s Day Love, Kendrick Lamar’s Super Bowl Performance, & NBA All-Star Weekend Highlights
programme.desc: In this exciting first episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, hosts Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith dive into all the hottest topics of the season! From the magic of Valentine’s Day love to Kendrick Lamar’s unforgettable Super Bowl halftime performance, this episode covers it all. Plus, get the inside scoop on the NBA All-Star Weekend, the biggest highlights, and what made it so memorable. Join us for a fun and lively conversation about music, sports, and everything in between!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 003: Nike Scandal, Lakers x One Piece Collab, and LA’s Strict Nightlife Rules & Discrimination
programme.desc: In this episode of Mic’d Up: The Podcast, Michelangelo Falcon and Daniel Smith tackle some of the hottest topics in pop culture and beyond. First up: The mystery behind stolen Nikes—did Nike orchestrate the theft themselves? Then, they dive into the collaboration between the Lakers and One Piece, along with opening exclusive One Piece trading cards! The conversation heats up as they discuss the SAG Awards and the controversial nightlife rules and discrimination issues in big cities like LA. Tune in for an insightful, no-holds-barred discussion on current events and pop culture!

programme.title: Mic’d Up The Podcast Season 1 Episode 004: Oscar Buzz, Pokémon Prismatic ETB Box Break, and the Mavericks' Downfall with Kyrie Irving
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of Mic'd: The Podcast Mic & Daniel dive into the latest buzz from the Oscars and what’s making headlines in Hollywood. programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eight: Perspective and Peace: Embracing Gratitude
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay dive into a thought-provoking discussion about the significance of perspective in our lives. They explore the difference between needs and wants, sharing personal stories and reflecting on how our mindset shapes our appreciation for what we have. The conversation touches on topics like Southern California's unpredictable weather, the desire for new possessions, and the impact of modern society on our perceptions of adequacy. Danielle challenges herself and the listeners to differentiate between 'needs' and 'wants,' emphasizing gratitude and contentment. The episode encourages listeners to reflect on their own lives, offering humorous anecdotes and real-life examples to drive home the message of intentional living and genuine self-reflection.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Eleven: The Weight of a Mother's Faith Our Sickle Cell Testimony Part One
programme.desc: In this heartfelt episode of Pardon My Peace, Danielle shares the moving story of her son, Thomas Parker III, who was born with sickle cell disease. She recounts Parker's birth experience, early health challenges, and the emotional journey from initial diagnosis to ongoing care. With faith, determination, and a strong support system, Danielle navigates the complexities of raising a child with chronic illness, while ensuring he leads a fulfilling life. This episode provides a deep look into the resilience and love that drive a mother's commitment to her child’s well-being.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Five: Empowerment in Solitude: Date Yourself!
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Pardon My Peace,' Danielle and Shay discuss the concept of 'dating yourself.' They explore personal experiences and the benefits of taking time for self-care and doing things solo. The conversation touches on growing confidence, the importance of self-love, and how societal expectations often make such practices challenging. Whether you're single, in a relationship, or a busy mom, they share insights on how to make time for yourself and why it's essential for overall well-being. Tune in for an inspiring discussion on normalizing self-dates, building confidence, and celebrating individuality.

programme.title: Pardon My Peace Season One Episode Four: DEA Busts, Fiery Conversations, and Dating Dilemmas
